explanation: Japanese researchers photographed a live giant squid with a camera on a baited line off the Ogasawara Islands. Until then, the animal was known mainly from dead or dying specimens.

claims.text: The first crewed Moon landing, Apollo 11, took place in July 1969.
The first photographs of a live giant squid in its natural deep-sea habitat were taken in September 2004, off Japan's Ogasawara Islands.
Japanese researchers photographed the squid with a camera attached to a baited line.
Before those photographs, giant squid were known mainly from dead or dying specimens found at the surface or washed ashore.
